question: What identity is invoked through the repeated address to the form of auspicious good fortune?
premises: The compound names a form of good fortune and auspiciousness
The same epithet is repeated four times
inference: The repeated invocation emphasizes and sanctifies the form embodying auspicious good fortune.
plain_english: O form of auspicious good fortune, O form of auspicious good fortune, O form of auspicious good fortune, O form of auspicious good fortune!
